title: Public data health page
points: Added a public Data Health page that explains how psxGPT checks filings before answering.
Users can now see corpus-level coverage across the full parsed history, clean/caution/known-issue counts, and searchable ticker-level cautions in plain language.
The public view keeps operational repair details private while still showing when a caution is scoped to a specific ticker, period, table, or metric.
